<thought>Using the primary ESI‑MS peak at m/z 235.1395 as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 234.1322 Da. The formula that best matches this mass with only C, H, O atoms is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (calculated mass = 234.1256 Da, within a few mDa of the target).</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
